summary: Verification-only round confirming both .env files exist and are loaded end to end. /app/backend/.env has MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD, EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY, EMAIL_FROM_NAME, EMAIL_REPLY_TO, FRONTEND_URL; /app/frontend/.env has REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://crm-dispatch-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend proofs via public URL: GET /api/ = 200; POST /api/auth/login (admin) = 200 and sets httpOnly access_token + refresh_token cookies (JWT signed => JWT_SECRET loaded); GET /api/auth/me = 200 returns admin user; GET /api/dashboard/stats = 200 with real DB aggregates (=> MONGO_URL/DB_NAME loaded); GET /api/email/preview?template=welcome&ref_id=<lead> = 200 with to/subject/html (=> email config loads). Full backend suite is GREEN: `python -m pytest tests/ -q` => 126 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (the 6 stale round3/round4 rate assertions flagged in iteration_5 are now fixed). Frontend: /login renders, admin login succeeds and lands on / dashboard showing live figures, and Dashboard/Leads/Itineraries/Bookings/Vendors routes all render with no console errors (=> REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly baked into the React build). Auth playbook re-verified: bcrypt hash prefix $2b$12$, httpOnly+Secure cookies, app-level CORS returns explicit origin + access-control-allow-credentials: true (the wildcard seen through the ingress is the edge proxy's preflight, FastAPI's own response on :8001 is explicit), brute-force lockout returns 429 on the 6th consecutive failure, seed_users runs idempotently at startup. Company WhatsApp is still 919876543210 and demo proposal /share/IxwAnPBYwGI is alive (200, accepted=False after reset). No code or .env file was modified. Conclusion: the reported issue is 'files exist but were hidden by the file browser' - no defect.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:32 uses os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*') - the '*' default would silently break credentialed cookie auth if CORS_ORIGINS is ever missing; prefer failing fast on the missing key.
tests/cleanup_test_data.py cascade-deletes bookings/invoices of TEST_ itineraries - correct behaviour, but future test agents should be aware it wipes any booking attached to a TEST_ itinerary.

rca_of_the_issue: No defect. Both .env files are present on disk as hidden dotfiles and are loaded correctly - proven transitively by successful JWT login (JWT_SECRET), DB-backed dashboard stats (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME), email preview rendering (EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY/EMAIL_FROM_NAME), and the React app reaching the backend through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. The user's file browser was simply hiding dotfiles.
